name: Progressive Muscle Relaxation
equipment: A quiet space to lie down (or sit comfortably)
instructions: Sit or lie down comfortably, and take a few deep breaths.
Clench your fists tightly for 5 seconds, then release, noticing the difference.
Do the same with your shoulders — raise them to your ears, hold, then let go.
Scrunch your face muscles tightly, then release completely.
Take a final deep breath, noticing the relaxation throughout your body.
